criteria.requirement: A recognizable genuine 3D wedding band supports comparing yellow gold, platinum and rose gold.
criteria.action: Select yellow gold, platinum and rose gold and inspect the band.
criteria.expected: A recognizable 3D wedding band renders distinguishable selected materials.

criteria.requirement: Band-width adjustment visibly changes the ring geometry.
criteria.action: Change the band width across its available range.
criteria.expected: The ring geometry visibly becomes narrower or wider.

criteria.requirement: Editable engraving is previewed on the inside surface of the ring and can be inspected.
criteria.action: Enter engraving text and use the available inspection views.
criteria.expected: The entered engraving appears on the ring's inside surface and is inspectable.

criteria.requirement: A design image can be downloaded reflecting chosen material, width and engraving where visible.
criteria.action: Download an image after changing material, width and engraving.
criteria.expected: The image reflects the current design, including engraving where the chosen view makes it visible.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the default band, interior and available metals.
Compare all three metals, change width and edit engraving, then inspect the inside.
Change the design again and download the current image; inspect its content and check that controls remain usable after view changes.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
